description:
TOP Tender Operating Platform helps Croatian businesses review procurement opportunities matched to their company profile and analyze published public-procurement records.

Signed-in users can list and inspect relevant tenders, review deadlines, lots, award criteria and published documents, and retrieve an individual document for a tender their organisation is authorized to view.

The analytics tools search suppliers, buyers and procurements; summarize markets by period and CPV scope; rank competitors; review participation and award history; list bidders; and inspect contract details.

Relevant-tender data is private to the signed-in Tender-Op organisation. Analytics are based on published Croatian procurement records. The app only retrieves information and files. It cannot create, edit or submit bids or change procurement records.

A Tender-Op account with TOP Connect access is required.

defaultPrompt: Which new public tenders are relevant for my company this month?
Who are my main competitors for CPV 45000000, and how often do they win?
Who bid on procurement 46779, and what was the contract worth?
